posts.headline: Ten straight editions of dead air and One Nut Barner STILL hasn't said a word — Put it in Ra rides a 20-8 record and a 1.5 average finish into Week 1 with zero rings and the loudest silence in league history.
posts.detail: A 20-8 career mark and back-to-back title-game finishes (1st, 2nd) is Cowboys-level pedigree, but this league has watched him ghost ten straight editions without confirming he even drafted a team. Talk now, One Nut, or let the losses do it for you.

posts.headline: Big Head rebranded nothing and changed nothing — Sasinci still has to prove a title banner belongs over a 13-15 career record once real football starts.
posts.detail: Alxgalvn's Megamind act has survived nine editions of excuses, but a 5.5 average finish and a habit of threatening to quit monthly don't inspire confidence heading into Week 1. The milk man bit is funny; the résumé is not.

posts.headline: talentedtenthh drafted a whole new roster and still enters Week 1 owning the single worst résumé in Busters Anonymous history.
posts.detail: A 4-10 record and a dead-last 12th-place finish don't get erased by an offseason — the untalented tenth needs Week 1 receipts, not just a fresh name on the lineup card.

posts.headline: Championshipsovercoochie's team name talks a big game, but the African Bald Fraud's 15-13 record and stuck-at-4th finish says the coochie's been winning more than the championships.
posts.detail: mjwithgoldhoops has never finished better than 4th in two seasons — if the name doesn't start matching the results in Week 1, the Bald Fraud label writes itself again.

posts.headline: The Clown Show kept the name and the middling 15-13 career mark — the Alaskan Bull Worm needs to actually play like the pro athlete he thinks he is once Week 1 hits.
posts.detail: btkempski has a 1st-place finish buried in that history but also a 7th-place disaster, and a delusional Packers-superfan swagger to match neither extreme — this league is watching to see which version shows up.
